description: Kazoo node capacity and errors: memory and pressure per service, CouchDB databases (size, activity, errors), application error messages (Kazoo, RabbitMQ, FreeSWITCH, CouchDB), RabbitMQ and Valkey state. Source: node_exporter + scripts/kazoo_service_metrics.sh.

panels.description: One row per server. Service columns: UP/DOWN, blank = not installed on that server (e.g. no RabbitMQ on ucpin13). Colours: green ok, orange warning, red action needed.
panels.title: Server Summary

targets.expr: max by (server_name) (count by (server_name) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing",server_name=~"$server"}) or max by (server_name) (up{job="debian_servers",cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}) * 0)

panels.description: One row per server + container / systemd service (cgroup v2). App memory = what the processes use; Cache = reclaimable page cache. Pressure = % of time stalled waiting for that resource (0.00 = no contention).
panels.title: Services

panels.description: Application (non-cache) memory per service, stacked, against 80% of RAM (the alert line). Compare calm vs peak hours to decide tuning vs a bigger plan.
panels.title: App Memory by Service

panels.description: Memory and CPU stall % per service; only services with real contention are shown.
panels.title: Pressure by Service

panels.description: Largest databases (by size, every 15 min) and busiest databases (by requests, every minute). CouchDB time % = request time per minute: the database's share of CouchDB work (CouchDB has no per-database CPU/RAM).
panels.title: Databases: Size, Activity & Errors

panels.description: Most frequent error/warning messages in the Kazoo log per minute (ids and numbers shown as #). Updated every minute.
panels.title: Kazoo Errors

panels.description: Most frequent error/warning messages in the RabbitMQ log per minute (ids and numbers shown as #). Updated every minute.
panels.title: RabbitMQ Errors

panels.description: Most frequent error/warning messages in the FreeSWITCH log per minute (ids and numbers shown as #). Updated every minute.
panels.title: FreeSWITCH Errors

panels.description: Most frequent error/warning messages in the CouchDB log per minute (ids and numbers shown as #). Updated every minute.
panels.title: CouchDB Errors

panels.description: AMQP connections and channels per client host. Channels cost broker memory.
panels.title: RabbitMQ Clients

panels.description: Queues holding messages (ready + unacked). Empty = no backlog.
panels.title: RabbitMQ Deepest Queues

panels.description: Queue store state. Evicted keys must stay 0 (queue data).
panels.title: Valkey & Sentinel

title: Kazoo Platform Health
